reason: Copy of postcss 8.4.31 pinned inside next. It only processes this project's own CSS at build time, never untrusted input. npm only offers a fix by moving to Next 16 (a major upgrade).
Same copy of postcss as above: build-time only, own CSS only. Goes away with the next Next.js release that updates its postcss pin.

Used by the Prisma CLI to merge prisma.config.ts, a trusted file written by the operator. Fixing it needs deepmerge-ts 8 (a major) inside Prisma itself; npm's suggested fix is to downgrade Prisma to 6, which is not acceptable.
Only reachable through `prisma dev` (Prisma's local development database). This project uses PostgreSQL and never starts it; no MySQL connection is ever made.
